label_rule: window labeled by logged work: training if any gradient step, else inference if any forward pass, else other
job_rule: any positive window; not majority rank vote

operational.rule: any positive window; episodes rearm after a negative or >1.5-stride gap
operational.exposure: union of observed windows in jobs with no training-labeled windows
operational.detection_delay_bounds_note: Onset bounded by first STEP-labeled training window, requiring an adjacent STEP-backed negative. Already-training first observations and gaps are censored. Quantiles are detected jobs only; program-only onsets excluded. Misses reported separately.
